references.text: The relationship between the bride and groom is used to illustrate the relationship between God and his people, which resembles the parable of the ten virgins waiting for the bridegroom.
John the Baptist refers to Jesus as the bridegroom, suggesting a connection to the parable of the ten virgins.
A psalm describing a royal wedding ceremony can be seen as a precursor to the parable of the ten virgins.
The description of the marriage supper of the Lamb in Revelation has parallels to the parable of the ten virgins, with a focus on preparation for the wedding.
